_note: Heat-exchanger geometry for plantagent/hxdetail.py. Every field names its source; ILLUSTRATIVE marks values that are not on the DEXPI P&ID or the data sheet (typical construction, to be replaced by the vendor data sheet).

H1007.service: Product cooler: aqueous ethanol product (line 47122) against cooling water WK (lines 47130/47131)

model_U.why: data sheet: U 600 W/m2K fouled (2024 test), 900 W/m2K after the 2019 clean

hot.source: DWSIM liquid properties of the product composition (model feed 47121) with the model's property package

cold.source: cooling water: IAPWS-95 density and cp, IAPWS 2008 viscosity, IAPWS 2011 conductivity (chemicals)

plate_length_m.source: P&ID H1007 PlateHeight 850 mm (taken as port-to-port length)

plate_k_W_mK.source: P&ID chamber material 1.4306; EN 10088-1 thermal conductivity 15 W/m K at 20 C

hot.source: typical practice for plate exchangers (fouling margins far below TEMA shell-and-tube values, about 0.00001-0.00005 m2K/W)

cold.source: typical practice for plate exchangers on treated cooling water

hot.source: data sheet: H1007 product-side pressure drop 0.3 bar at 18 m3/h

cold.source: data sheet: H1007 cooling-water pressure drop 0.5 bar at 20 m3/h

channel_velocity_min_m_s.source: typical practice for plate exchangers: below about 0.1 m/s channel velocity, maldistribution and fouling rise

dP_cold_max_bar.source: data sheet: 1.0 bar available pressure drop across H1007 on the cooling-water branch

dP_hot_max_bar.source: typical practice for liquids (35-70 kPa); product-side allowable not on the data sheet

H1008.service: Tank recirculation cooler: aqueous ethanol product (line 47126) on the shell, chilled water QS (lines 47140/47141) in the tubes

model_U.why: data sheet: U 600 W/m2K at the current flows (2024 performance test, fouled)

hot.source: DWSIM liquid properties of the product composition (model feed 47121) with the model's property package

cold.source: chilled water: IAPWS-95 density and cp, IAPWS 2008 viscosity, IAPWS 2011 conductivity (chemicals)

shell_baffle_clearance_m.source: ILLUSTRATIVE: typical diametral shell-to-baffle clearance for an 800 mm shell

tube_baffle_clearance_m.source: ILLUSTRATIVE: typical diametral tube-hole clearance (1/32 in)

tube_k_W_mK.source: P&ID H1008 TubeMaterialOfConstructionCode 1.4306; EN 10088-1 thermal conductivity 15 W/m K at 20 C

tube.source: TEMA RGP-T-2.4: distilled water / closed-cycle condensate 0.0005 h ft2 F/Btu (closed chilled-water loop)

shell.source: TEMA RGP-T-2.4 typical process liquid 0.001 h ft2 F/Btu

tube_velocity_min_m_s.source: typical practice for water in tubes, 1-3 m/s (Sinnott, Coulson & Richardson's Chemical Engineering Vol. 6, sec. 12.7)

dP_tube_max_bar.source: typical practice for liquids (35-70 kPa); chilled-water allowable not on the data sheet
